page.title: Settings & Readiness
page.purpose: Expose mode, credential metadata, capability-scoped readiness, sync preview, and the protected-versus-anonymous public-assets boundary.

priorities.statement: Name the exact capability affected by missing credentials or insufficient scopes.

Explain that only /public/* can bypass Access and the primary application remains protected.

regions.purpose: Render credential readiness and public-assets policy through loading, ready, partial, and failed states.
